facts.fact: The page states that Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L, setting up the RNPP and the NNI, was promulgated on 21 January 2019; the page has no date of its own (published date 2024 used for the page only).
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)

facts.fact: The page says the law set up a centralised biometric national register of persons and a NNI, a unique code assigned from birth and compulsory for all institutions.
facts.system: Loi n° 39/AN/19/8ème L (2019, national identification number and national register of persons)
